description: The same questions asked after each episode of new material. Before the material exists the right answer is to abstain (premature confidence fails); after it lands the answer must use it; later episodes require combining material across episodes. The reported number is the change in pass rate from the first episode to the last. Synthetic: Vireo Labs, Kestrel Bio and Harrow Instruments are invented. Design modeled on the engine's compounding suite (episode clock, abstention, retrieval/reconciliation strata).

cases.title: Vireo Labs: picking a lead compound across three episodes
cases.notes: Scoring changed 2026-10-10 (scorer 2026-10-10.2): the lead asks use must_not_assert (see kestrel-batch-release).

steps.title: VL-series assay plan
steps.summary: Plan for the VL-series kinase inhibitor screen.

sections.title: Plan
sections.body: Vireo Labs will screen VL-07, VL-12 and VL-19 against the KX2 kinase in a biochemical IC50 assay starting the week of 2026-03-02. No potency results exist yet.

steps.label: e1-potency
steps.question: What IC50 did VL-12 reach against KX2?
steps.expectation: Abstain: the assay has not produced results yet.

steps.label: e1-lead
steps.question: Which VL compound was chosen as the lead against KX2?
steps.expectation: Abstain: no lead has been chosen.

steps.title: VL-series KX2 IC50 results
steps.summary: Biochemical IC50 results for the VL series against KX2.

sections.title: Results
sections.body: In the KX2 biochemical IC50 assay of 2026-03-20, VL-12 reached an IC50 of 41 nM, VL-07 reached 380 nM and VL-19 was inactive above 10 uM.

steps.label: e2-potency
steps.question: What IC50 did VL-12 reach against KX2?

steps.label: e2-lead
steps.question: Which VL compound was chosen as the lead against KX2?
steps.expectation: Results exist but no decision yet; abstain from naming a chosen lead.

steps.title: Lead selection decision 2026-04-02
steps.summary: VL-12 advanced as the KX2 lead.

sections.title: Decision
sections.body: On 2026-04-02 the Vireo Labs program team chose VL-12 as the KX2 lead compound because it had the best IC50 against KX2 and no hERG signal at 10 uM. VL-07 is the backup.

steps.label: e3-potency
steps.question: What IC50 did VL-12 reach against KX2?

steps.label: e3-lead
steps.question: Which VL compound was chosen as the lead against KX2, and what was its IC50?
steps.expectation: VL-12, 41 nM, combining the episode 2 results with the episode 3 decision.

cases.title: Kestrel Bio: a batch release that depends on two later results
cases.notes: Scoring changed 2026-10-10 (scorer 2026-10-10.2): the release asks use must_not_assert, not must_not_include. The correct answer declines to claim release, and a literal ban failed answers that said they could not confirm 'KB-2207 was released'. An asserted release still fails, including one beside unrelated uncertainty. Earlier reports keep their original scores; rescored copies are labelled (beakr_bench.rescore).

sections.title: Record
sections.body: Kestrel Bio manufactured lot KB-2207 of the KB-4 antibody on 2026-05-04. Release requires a passing sterility test and an endotoxin result below 0.5 EU/mL.

steps.label: e1-release
steps.question: Was lot KB-2207 released?
steps.expectation: Abstain: release depends on tests not yet reported.

sections.title: Result
sections.body: The 14-day sterility test for lot KB-2207 passed on 2026-05-18 with no growth.

steps.title: Lot KB-2207 endotoxin and release
steps.summary: Endotoxin result and release of lot KB-2207.

sections.title: Release
sections.body: Lot KB-2207 measured 0.12 EU/mL endotoxin on 2026-05-21 and quality assurance released lot KB-2207 on 2026-05-22.

steps.label: e3-release
steps.question: Was lot KB-2207 released, and on what results?

cases.title: Harrow Instruments: a drift explained only when two episodes are combined

sections.title: Calibration
sections.body: HPLC-3 at Harrow Instruments was calibrated on 2026-06-01 using reference standard lot RS-118.

steps.label: e1-drift
steps.question: Why did HPLC-3 retention times drift in June 2026?
steps.expectation: Abstain: no drift is recorded yet.

steps.title: HPLC-3 retention time drift
steps.summary: Retention time drift observed on HPLC-3.

sections.title: Observation
sections.body: From 2026-06-10 HPLC-3 retention times drifted 0.4 minutes late across all methods.

steps.title: Reference standard RS-118 recall
steps.summary: Recall of reference standard lot RS-118.

sections.title: Recall
sections.body: The supplier recalled reference standard lot RS-118 on 2026-06-20 because it degraded in storage; HPLC-3 calibration and drift should be rechecked with lot RS-121.

steps.label: e2-drift
steps.question: Why did HPLC-3 retention times drift in June 2026?
steps.expectation: The calibration used RS-118, which was later recalled as degraded.
